subject: Post-demo procurement triage: AP gate, card blockers, PO playbook
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@medinary.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@medinary.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo procurement triage: AP gate, card blockers, PO playbook

Hi Lisa / ProcureOps team —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick follow-up from our side to make sure we route the commercial path correctly and avoid surprises during onboarding. TL;DR: we need to confirm whether Medinary requires a PO/ACH-only flow or if a credit card/marketplace option is possible for initial pilot.

Recap + items for confirmation:
- Procurement constraints you mentioned: vendor approval and tax-doc requirements (need confirmation on exact docs).
- Card blockers: do you allow new vendors to be paid on a corporate card? Any dollar thresholds or MCC restrictions?
- PO process: typical lead time once vendor paperwork is submitted (vendor pre-approval -> PO issuance -> first payment).
- Marketplace: is buying via a marketplace (AWS/GCP/Hashi etc) acceptable for pilots, or is procurement forbidding marketplace spend for vendors not already pre-vetted?

Our suggested next steps:
1) We can share a 1-page pricing breakdown + SOW (attached: pricing_breakdown.xlsx, redwood_sow_template.pdf). Can you confirm the minimum fields ProcureOps needs to start vendor onboarding?
2) If PO is mandatory, please share the PO template or required fields so we can align our legal and finance teams (we can fill draft_po_template.docx).
3) If card is allowed, what single-payment limit would be required for pilot purchases?

Attachments: procurement_quick-check.xlsx (short checklist), pricing_breakdown.xlsx, redwood_sow_template.pdf

Aim is to avoid a 4–6 week stall in onboarding — happy to jump on a 15-min triage with your procurement rep if that accelerates things.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
vivEk.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@medinary.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@medinary.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement triage: AP gate, card blockers, PO playbook

Hi Vivek —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement side:

1) Vendor onboarding basics: Medinary requires an approved vendor packet — W9, company formation docs, proof of insurance (if tech integrations), and a vendor questionnaire. Our vendor-supplier-form.pdf covers the required fields. Once packet is complete and reviewed, typical internal SLA for vendor approval is 2–3 business days, but it can slip to 3–4 weeks if legal/review flags show up.

2) Payment method policy: Our AP team prefers ACH or PO-based invoices for new vendors. Corporate card payments for third-party software are allowed only if the vendor is on our pre-approved list or if the charge is below $5,000 and approved by procurement. New vendors are rarely given immediate card access.

3) Marketplace purchases: At present we do not allow marketplace purchases for vendors that are not already in our vendor registry due to software compliance tracking. If Redwood is able to be listed in our marketplace vendor registry quickly (procureops: is that possible?), we could consider that as an alternative route.

4) PO specifics: Please send a sample invoice and SOW with line-item pricing and tax ID. We need a cost center and GL code for a PO; if you provide suggested defaults we can draft an initial PO to keep momentum.

Attaching vendor-supplier-form.pdf — please have your legal/operations team complete and return.

Thanks,
Lisa Park
Head of Procurement | Medinary Therapeutics
lisa.park@medinary.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@medinary.com>, ProcureOps <procureops@medinary.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement triage: AP gate, card blockers, PO playbook

Thanks Lisa — that's super helpful and pragmatic. Summarizing actions so nothing falls through the cracks:

A) Actions from Redwood (Vivek / Karthik / Monica)
- Vivek: Share a one-page SOW and per-seat/per-month pricing + initial pilot invoice example by Wed 12 Aug EOD (attached: pricing_breakdown.xlsx, redwood_sow_template.pdf).
- Karthik: Prepare a condensed security/compliance summary for ProcureOps (2 pager) so they can fast-track vendor review if needed.
- Monica: Standby to accept a draft PO from Medinary and run a quick legal/finance gap check on Redwood's PO fields (if you can send draft_po_template.docx, we'll fill & return).

B) Questions for Medinary / ProcureOps
- ProcureOps: Can the marketplace vendor registry be used as a shortcut? If so, what's the process and who is the owner?
- Lisa: If we submit the vendor packet and SOW today, can you estimate target date for PO issuance? (we are seeing 4–6 weeks in other accounts and would like to avoid that).

C) Escalation option: If vendor onboarding looks like it will exceed two weeks, would Medinary accept a short-term card payment for the first month while PO is processed? We understand the $5k threshold you mentioned — would you consider a one-off exception for pilots under a written memo?

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6789012 (deal HG-2026-3087)

I'll attach the SOW and pricing in a follow-up. Happy to join a quick triage call if that helps.

Best,
Vivek

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo procurement triage: AP gate, card blockers, PO playbook (internal)

Quick internal note — forwarding playbook items and next steps:

- I'll review the draft PO when Lisa sends it and confirm any required contract clauses (net terms, indemnity language). Expect a 48–72 hour turnaround for review unless legal flags emerge.
- I'll attach redwood_sow_template.pdf and draft_po_template.docx in my response to ProcureOps; we should pre-fill GL code suggestions and tax ID to reduce back-and-forth.
- If ProcureOps insists on a full vendor packet, we'll request ProcureOps to accept a short vendor packet for pilots (minimal required fields) + a statement of work as a conditional acceptance.

I'll wait for Vivek's SOW and Karthik's compliance summary, then I will prepare the filled PO template and vendor packet to return.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
